guidance: It has a total project outlay of INR1,86,405 crores wit h central financial support of INR 54,082 crores and is targeted for completion by FY32-33.
Mohit Kumar: My last question is, Would you like to revise your RE capacity addition target, given the fact that we've added only nearly 1.3 gigawatt, if I'm correct, in the first half H1?
capex: As on H1 FY27, NTPC Group's installed capacity stood at 91,506 megawatts.
We have added 2,398 megawatts of capacity, out of which NTPC is 196 megawatts, NGEL Group is 1,136 megawatts and other group companies have added 1,066 megawatts.
risks: Close to 1615 megawatt is something which would be on the ground, but which will be covered under probably the delay in the transmission.
So, as you said, transmission has been a challenge for us and for others as well, hence our guidance has been cut.
focus: Alongside this, we will strengthen fuel security by maximizing production from captive mines, diversified coal sourcing, and close coordination with suppliers and transport agencies.
Across these initiatives, we will remain focused on disciplined capital allocation, cost control, and operational excellence.
Management: We are targeting by December this year or January next, as far as Sinnar is concerned.
